claims.claim: At Agbogbloshie, lead contamination was predominantly caused by burning the plastic covering of copper wires.
claims.episode_span: teenagers pry open smartphone casings with screwdrivers and set the plastic on fire to free the copper wiring inside
claims.supporting_quote: Environmental lead contamination was predominantly due to burning the plastic covering of copper wires.

claims.claim: Workers at Agbogbloshie, including children, disassemble and process scrap electronics.
claims.episode_span: Workers, frequently including children, burned insulation to recover copper and gold
claims.supporting_quote: Workers, children and adults alike, disassemble cars, appliances, and scrap electronics, gathered in wheeled push carts from Accra neighborhoods.

claims.claim: The Basel Convention is the international treaty designed to reduce transboundary movements of hazardous waste and specifically restrict its transfer from developed to less developed countries.
claims.episode_span: export rules under the Basel Convention proved difficult to enforce for small, high-value items
claims.supporting_quote: is an international treaty that was designed to reduce the movements of hazardous waste between nations, and specifically to restrict the transfer of hazardous waste from developed to less developed countries

claims.claim: The EU's WEEE Directive set collection, recycling and recovery targets for electrical goods.
claims.episode_span: The European Union’s WEEE Directive and later Right to Repair proposals required greater parts availability and easier battery removal
claims.source_title: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Directive - Wikipedia
claims.supporting_quote: The WEEE Directive set collection , recycling and recovery targets for all types of electrical goods , with a minimum rate of 4 kilograms (9 lb) per head of population per annum recovered for recycling by 2009.
